summary_en: 22,760 shares (0.03% S/O) to be acquired at no cost on 2026-09-03 and cancelled on 2026-09-15, arising from termination of performance-linked equity incentive plan for directors; trust terminates 2026-08-31.
title_en: Notice regarding gratuity acquisition and cancellation of treasury shares accompanying termination of performance-linked equity incentive plan for directors
translation_en_brief: On 26 August 2026, SIGMAXYZ Holdings' board resolved to acquire and cancel 22,760 treasury shares arising from termination of its performance-linked equity incentive plan for directors. The underlying trust, established in 2016 and most recently extended (as reported 8 May 2025), terminates on 31 August 2026. Upon trust termination, 22,760 shares remain in the trust and will be acquired by the company at no cost (gratuity) on 3 September 2026 under Company Law Article 155(13) and implementing rule 27(1), then cancelled on 15 September 2026 under Company Law Article 178. The shares represent 0.03% of issued shares outstanding (ex-treasury). No purchase price is payable; acquisition is automatic under the trust deed.
